Marta: Quick sync 1 building the webinar landing + a short battlecard: focus = benchmarks -> buyer path -> inbound routing. Goal: a 60s pitch vs managed cloud endpoints and a routing matrix.
Devon: Need 30s rebut for 'we use managed endpoints' 1 SMB + Enterprise variants.
Ken: Lead with two measurable diffs: predictable unit economics (reserved capacity) and routing/fallback to avoid outages. Can we share a safe range (e.g., 30-60% cost delta) if legal ok?
Aisha: Landing CTAs: "Request benchmark" -> Bench SDR, "Book demo" -> AE. Add microfield: use case (chat/embeddings) for routing. I'll map HubSpot workflows.
Riley: Battlecard one-liners for SDRs (copy/paste length):
- Buyer: "We use CloudX managed endpoints"
  SDR: "Many start there. Redwood keeps your API but gives predictable capacity + fallbacks. Want a 1hr bench?"
- Buyer: "We can't manage infra"
  SDR: "Start Hosted; migrate to Dedicated as you scale. We support the path."
Devon: Post-webinar email (short):
Subject: Redwood bench offer
Hi {{name}},
Thanks for joining. Want a short bench on your workload? We'll return latency + unit-cost deltas and a routing rec.
Schedule: [link]
Marta: Action items: Ken -> final ranges + legal blurb (EOD). Aisha -> HubSpot route IDs (tomorrow AM). Devon/Riley -> 6 two-line plays by EOD. I'll merge into the landing + battlecard and circulate.
